Name: Bonsai Trees
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
[size=3][b]What does this mod do?
[/b][/size]This mod is a content pack that adds six new bonsai tree decorative furniture pieces using the Dynamic Game Assets framework. 
[b][size=3]
How to use:[/size][/b][list]
[*]Make sure you have DGA installed.
[*]Put this folder (unzipped) into your mods folder, and it should be good to go!
[/list][size=3][b]
How to remove:
[/b][/size]Make sure you have deleted all instances of the new furniture before removing this folder from your mods folder. 
[b][size=3]
Where do I buy the new furniture?
[/size][/b]You can get one bonsai tree each day at Robin’s. Each day of the week has a different tree. 
[size=3][b]
Known DGA bugs that may come up:[/b][/size][list]
[*]None, let me know if you find one!
[/list]
[b][size=3]Translations:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]English, Spanish, and Chinese (simplified/traditional) were done by me. 
[*]French, German, and Italian were done by me and Misha. Russian was done by Misha. 
[*]Portuguese was very kindly done by Roxas, whose mod page containing some translations can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/73534233?tab=user+files]at this link[/url]﻿. 
[*]Turkish was very kindly done by KediDili, whose mod page containing some nice mods can be found [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/225898]at this link[/url]﻿. 
[*]Japanese was very kindly done by bblueberry, whose mod page with some nice mods is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71169863?tab=user+files]at this link[/url]﻿.
[*]Korean and Hungarian were done by me with a lot of help from Google Translate, and proofreading of Hungarian done by Misha. Please do contact me if you have corrections!
[/list][b][size=3]
Inspiration and thanks:
[/size][/b]In making the art, I was inspired by Lumisteria’s many beautiful furniture packs in the vanilla art style. Also, I would like to thank Misha for all his help.
